summary: Reading a charging scroll reaches read.c:seffect_charging, but js/read.js:seffects records the effect as unported. C identifies and consumes the scroll before a chargeable-object prompt, then read.c:recharge changes the selected wand. Port the complete source family, including recharge branches and other active callers; the selected wand case alone does not cover rings, tools, or explosion paths.

source.branch: seffect_charging handles confused hero energy separately, otherwise identifies and consumes the scroll before getobj(charge, charge_ok). A chosen item goes to recharge with -1, 0, or +1 from curse/bless. The selected case chooses a wand; recharge handles cancellation, explosion chance from prior recharge count, charge ceiling, source-ordered RNG, object glow messages, and cap_spe. The same function has ring and tool branches with different state effects.
callers: read.c:seffects SCR_CHARGING arm calls seffect_charging; js/read.js:seffects currently records note_unported(read.c seffect_charging).

read.c:seffect_charging calls recharge after getobj; other C callers include artifacts.c recharge invocation and zap.c destruction effects, represented by explicit read.c recharge gaps in js/artifacts.js and js/zap_destroy_items.js.
dependencies: read.c:charge_ok and learnscroll already have JavaScript implementations in js/read.js; getobj, useup, object discovery, and prompt ordering must match C.

read.c:recharge owns stripspe and p_glow helpers. Its wand_explode, Ring_off/gone, burn, shop, HP, and cap_spe effects require source-matched callees or explicit discarded-result gaps under AGENTS.md.
The selected wand path is only one object class; independent recordings must cover active ring/tool and cursed/blessed paths before source completion.
